parameters.name: FILT_OPT
parameters.help: These three types of filters may be applied in F-K space: fan filters, power exponent, arbitrary polygon.

choices.label: Velocity
choices.help: Velocity units used to parameterize pie slice.

choices.label: Ms per trace
choices.help: Units of milliseconds per trace used to parameterize pie slice.

parameters.name: XSPACING
parameters.help: Distance between input traces, default to 0.0 for value from global parameters. Check job.output for value used.

parameters.name: PA_WIDTH
parameters.help: Number of traces to process at one time; use number of traces per ensemble for pre-stack.

parameters.name: IMPULSE
parameters.help: If 'YES', the output will be the impulse response of the filter; if 'NO', apply the filter to data.

parameters.name: TFLATPCT
parameters.help: The traces may be tapered prior to T-F transform to minimize FFT edge effects (100.0 = no ramping).

parameters.name: XFLATPCT
parameters.help: The offsets may be tapered prior to X-K transform to minimize FFT edge effects (100.0 = no ramping).

parameters.name: POWER
parameters.prompt: Power to raise F-K space to:
parameters.help:
The F-K transform values are raised to this power and then inverse 
transformed.

parameters.name: DB_OPT
parameters.prompt: Get polygon mute file from the database?
parameters.help: A polygon mute parm file may be selected from the database, or an arbitrary polygon may be specified manually.

parameters.name: POLYNAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a polygon (mute) parameter file description from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: POLYSTRN
parameters.help: Use MB1 to enter groups of (frequency-wavenumber) values to define a polygon. **SEE EXAMPLE!!!**

parameters.name: REJOPT
parameters.help: F-K filter can either pass or reject the specified F-K regions.

parameters.name: FFLATPCT
parameters.prompt: Percent flat for F-K filter windowing
parameters.help: The F-K filter may be ramped (in T-X) to control the smoothness of the filter.

parameters.name: TFILT_SZ
parameters.help: The F-K filter is transformed to T-X domain and windowed.  This will be the time extent of the filter.

parameters.name: XFILT_SZ
parameters.help: The F-K filter is transformed to T-X domain and windowed.  This will be the spatial extent of the filter.

parameters.name: REMUTE
parameters.prompt: Re-apply T-X trace mute after filter?
parameters.help: Trace mutes (such as first break suppression mutes) may be re-applied after filtering.

parameters.name: FAN_PARMVE
parameters.help:
Use MB1 to enter groups of velocity-frequency values to define pie 
slice(s) =>'1800,2300,5.5,22/-4500,-3500,8,40/'

parameters.name: FAN_PARMMS
parameters.help:
Use MB1 to enter groups of dip-frequency values to define pie 
slice(s) =>'8,2,5.5,22/-4,-3,8,40/'

parameters.name: KWRAP
parameters.prompt: Wrap fan in K-space past Nyquist?
parameters.help: Set this parameter to 'No' if you do NOT wish to wrap in K-space past K-Nyquist. Default 'Yes' means wrap past Nyquist.

parameters.name: KSUPPCT
parameters.help: Specify a percentage of total K-space to restrict F-K velocity filtering and prevent fan spreading at higher freqs.

parameters.name: TPCT_PAD
parameters.help: The percentage of zero padding for FFTs desired for the TIME filter.

parameters.name: XPCT_PAD
parameters.help: The percentage of zero padding for FFTs desired for the SPATIAL filter.

parameters.name: KSKEEPCT
parameters.prompt: Percentage of K-space to keep around K=0
parameters.help: The percentage of K-space to leave unfiltered in a corridor around K=0.
